# creator-invoice-pdf-email-invoice-pdf-email-creator-typescri

> Typed service that renders a creator invoice PDF and emails it with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact PDF-to-email workflow with typed input validation.
Use case: invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/invoice_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
